I replied in your thread in #inc-vtg-hartford.

- **First report:** 10:42 AM on 3 Aug, when you posted that the gate kiosks were offline at the Hartford plant and the guard was writing trailer numbers on a clipboard.
- **The guard in the meantime:** the room only shows that clipboard note. Mateo's 11:03 AM message says kiosk 1 was back and the guard checked in trailer 8836. Nothing in the room covers what the guard did between 10:42 and 11:03. The guard's own account would have to come from someone on site.
